comment: Class gauges (docs/COMBAT_LAB.md Part 3c): one meter and one spender per class.

fighter.name: Momentum
fighter.text: Pushes and collisions fill it. Spend: push every adjacent enemy.

mage.name: Heat
mage.text: Casting fills it. Spend: your next spell is 2 Magnitudes higher, then the meter locks for a round.

rogue.name: Shadow
rogue.text: Rounds nobody aims at you fill it. Spend: +3 Move and your next hit counts as from behind.

healer.name: Faith
healer.text: Healing and shielding fill it. Spend: revive an adjacent ally, or shield the most hurt one.

bard.name: Tempo
bard.text: Playing cards in a chain with allies fills it. Spend: an ally gets an extra Action on their next turn.
